question: Does public history-dependent compositional delay credit give actionable information beyond a flat history table, and does any gain survive the equally-informed exact symbolic rule control?
scope: public synthetic capability diagnostic only; not FKP17 original DEV/TRANSFER or native Yggdrasil

source_contract.observables: 8 integer public state registers [0..15], action in [0..7], earned scalar reward, public prior history <=16, terminal flag
source_contract.private_internal: world-specific shift in [0..7]; two-step-delayed reward generated by prior action vs (its predecessor action + its observed context bit + shift) % 8
source_contract.learner_input: only returned public transition tuples and historical public actions/states/rewards
source_contract.reward: first three interactions reward 0; subsequent t reward +1 if action at t-2 matches expression on its public context and prior action at t-3, otherwise -0.25
source_contract.exploration: same frozen 24-step public random action tape for all controls per world
source_contract.score: 16 on-policy actions after replayed common tape; sum of actually earned rewards
source_contract.time: exact 2-step action credit; no hidden-label or alternative-future access
source_contract.unfamiliarity: no claim of disjoint unknown law family: candidate and exact symbolic control share compositional hypothesis grammar
source_contract.source_seeds: public diagnostic 880000..880031; validation smoke 880100..880107; no protected FKP17 978500..978531 or 978600..978663

arms.STRUCTURED_VERSION_SPACE: 8-shift persistent context/predecessor/action hypotheses; eliminate only from genuinely observed delayed consequences; choose pre-outcome
arms.FLAT_TABULAR: exact observed (public predecessor,context,action) reward means, no extrapolation to unseen combos
arms.WRONG_CREDIT: attributes observed delayed reward to current action, explicit negative
arms.SYMBOLIC_EXACT: independent conventional exact eight-shift version-space control; identical public data, capacity and action budget
arms.ORACLE: private world-known upper bound; diagnostics only, not a competing learner

metrics.primary: mean true 16-step earned public reward across 32 fixed PUBLIC diagnostic worlds
metrics.accuracy: correct shift support remaining after 24 exploration actions, computed against source-private label only for retrospective diagnostic; not learner input
metrics.cost: measured source steps, CPU wall, parameter bytes; no unverifiable whole-process speed claims
metrics.classification: STRUCTURED matches SYMBOLIC_EXACT => NO_GO_FOR_NOVEL_SUBSTRATE_ADVANTAGE; missing headroom => INVALID_SOURCE; comparison beats flat alone => NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS

stopping.after_observed_results: freeze all parameters, source, thresholds, seeds and method; preserve negative outcomes
stopping.scope: do not tune on public diagnostic score and claim independent scientific novelty
stopping.acceptance: scientific pass requires disjoint unfamiliar source owner, strong conventional comparison, independently qualified cold retention and transfer, exact source dual-OS, project owner acceptance
